comparison.objective: Open a load-supported locker door and remove a leaning fragile case upright.
comparison.physical_skill: Manage a hidden load while withdrawing its supporting door, then transport and place it without tipping or dropping.
comparison.success_condition: Case never exceeds damage/drop limits and finishes upright, released, and still on the mat for 1 s.
comparison.reason: Support-transition handling of one fragile object is materially different from selective many-body separation through a sieve.
